intent: Android Agent crash logs can be captured from another Windows PC without truncating a discovered ADB path.
rollback: Remove the local diagnostic script; no installed application, device setting or service data is changed.

requestReview.reason: The manually launched local collector downloads one official Android Platform-Tools ZIP only when adb.exe is absent; it does not access Firebase or add background app traffic.
requestReview.assumptions: One operator on one Windows PC launches the collector once. If ADB is absent, that launch reads one Google-hosted ZIP and writes zero remote records; later runs reuse the extracted adb.exe. There are no timers, listeners, automatic retries or app service requests.

checks.idle: The collector has no scheduled task, timer, listener or background process; no launch means zero requests.
checks.rerender: The collector has no UI lifecycle or remount path; each explicit launch is counted as one client launch.
checks.concurrency: The script performs one synchronous Invoke-WebRequest per launch and shares no running service; concurrent manual launches may each download once and are outside the one-operator budget.
checks.failure: Invoke-WebRequest errors terminate because ErrorActionPreference is Stop; no retry loop is present.
checks.cleanup: The downloaded ZIP is removed after successful extraction, while extracted adb.exe is retained for future runs.

outcomes.acceptance: PC Viewer Connect while Android Agent is in background does not terminate the Agent; consent and approved first-frame delivery remain available.
outcomes.verification: 2026-09-06: focused Android native release, discovery and packaging tests passed 12 tests; focused Agent/Add-On test and compilation passed. Signed Android 0.1.83 Agent, Viewer and Control Add-On release build passed with WebRTC JNI mapping verification, signature verification and generated update metadata. Firebase Hosting publishes android-update.json versionCode 1083. GitHub Actions run 33985944437 passed and published v0.1.83 x86 Viewer/Agent installers plus signed update manifest. Download aliases redirect to the current release assets.
outcomes.physicalGap: Reproduce reported crash with logcat on affected device, then verify signed optimized APK background request, permission refusal, approval, first frame, disconnect and repeated connection on arm64/armv7.

outcomes.acceptance: On another Windows PC, an operator can launch a visible collector that returns the complete existing ADB path including C:\Android\sdk\platform-tools, clears Android logs, reproduces two Viewer connection attempts, and receives a ZIP containing logcat, device properties and Agent package state.
outcomes.verification: 2026-09-06: PowerShell collector self-test creates one fake adb.exe and verifies Get-FirstExistingPath returns its full path rather than the first character. npx vitest run src/androidCrashLogCollector.test.ts passed 3 tests.
outcomes.physicalGap: Requires the affected Android device connected to a separate Windows PC with USB debugging authorized; run the capture through both connection attempts and provide the generated ZIP.
